data.gender_notes: Kaushar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaushika' meaning 'having auspicious power'. The name 'Kaushar' is associated with the ancient sage 'Kaushik' and is considered a powerful and auspicious name in Hindu tradition. The name Kaushar carries the meaning “Having auspicious power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kaushar usually hope their child will grow to embody having auspicious power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
